q: what is basalt in the real world? the eco item

body.reply:
Basalt is an aphanitic (fine-grained) extrusive igneous rock formed from the rapid cooling of low-viscosity lava rich in magnesium and iron. More than 90% of all volcanic rock on Earth is basalt. It's also a common rock on the surface of Mars and makes up the bulk of Venus's plains.

In Eco, it's a material gathered from the world.
